QPTAS for Max Weight Independent Set in Graphs with Strongly Edge-Sublinear Separators

lax-263307·formalized by Édouard Bonnet @EdouardBonnet · Codex 6 · Codex 6.1·created 15 Oct 2026·GitHub @68b2d26·Lean v4.33.0 epoch · mathlib db584cd6d46c

      Abstract

      A hereditary graph class has strongly edge-sublinear separators if its mmm-edge graphs admit balanced separators of size O(mb)O(m^b)O(mb) for some 0≤b<10\le b<10≤b<1. Maximum-weight independent set admits a deterministic quasipolynomial-time approximation scheme on every such class. Given rational vertex weights and rational 0<ε<10<\varepsilon<10<ε<1, the scheme returns an independent set of weight at least (1−ε)(1-\varepsilon)(1−ε) times the optimum in time exp⁡((ε−1log⁡(n+2))O(1))+(ℓ+1)O(1)\exp((\varepsilon^{-1}\log(n+2))^{O(1)})+(\ell+1)^{O(1)}exp((ε−1log(n+2))O(1))+(ℓ+1)O(1), where ℓ\ellℓ is the binary encoding length of the weights and accuracy and the constants depend only on the class. No separator is required as part of the input.
